mapper.select: SELECT PLAN_SEQ, USER_ID, PLAN_TYPE_CODE, PLAN_NAME, DATE_FORMAT(PLAN_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PLAN_DATE, USE_YN, DEL_YN, INS_DT, INS_IP, INS_USER_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_IP, UPD_USER_ID FROM TB_PLAN WHERE PLAN_SEQ = #{planSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT PLAN_DETAIL_SEQ, PLAN_SEQ, PLAN_PHASE, PLAN_EXER_NAME, PLAN_CATEGORY_CODE, PLAN_KIND_CODE, PLAN_NOTE, PLAN_REPS, PLAN_SETS, PLAN_TIME, PLAN_TOTAL_DISTANCE, PLAN_SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, DEL_YN, INS_DT, INS_IP, INS_USER_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_IP, UPD_USER_ID FROM TB_PLAN_DETAIL WHERE PLAN_SEQ = #{planSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY PLAN_SORT_ORDER ASC, PLAN_DETAIL_SEQ ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PLAN SET PLAN_NAME = #{planName}, PLAN_DATE = #{planDate}, PLAN_TYPE_CODE = #{planTypeCode}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPD_DT = NOW(), UPD_IP = #{updIp}, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId} WHERE PLAN_SEQ = #{planSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE TB_PLAN SET DEL_YN = 'Y', UPD_DT = NOW(), UPD_IP = #{updIp}, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId} WHERE PLAN_SEQ = #{planSeq}

UPDATE TB_PLAN_DETAIL SET PLAN_PHASE = #{planPhase}, PLAN_EXER_NAME = #{planExerName}, PLAN_CATEGORY_CODE = #{planCategoryCode}, PLAN_KIND_CODE = #{planKindCode}, PLAN_NOTE = #{planNote}, PLAN_REPS = #{planReps}, PLAN_SETS = #{planSets}, PLAN_TIME = #{planTime}, PLAN_TOTAL_DISTANCE = #{planTotalDistance}, PLAN_SORT_ORDER = #{planSortOrder}, USE_YN = COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), DEL_YN = 'N', UPD_DT = NOW(), UPD_IP = #{updIp}, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId} WHERE PLAN_DETAIL_SEQ = #{planDetailSeq}
